Karnataka finds hospitals marking up drug prices up to 52 times

Karnataka government officials have discovered that several hospitals are selling high-cost drugs and consumables at markups ranging from 10 to 52 times their original price. The state government has flagged these significant price hikes, particularly for cancer drugs, and is seeking intervention from the central government.
